g++ -dynamiclib -current_version 1.0 -I -o libmyrectangle.dylib MyRectangle.cpp

author: Carl Dea
html:
Criss,
I’m assuming you’ve installed Xcode xcode-select —install. Also check out: https://github.com/carldea/java-panama-workshop/tree/main/installs

If you installed the above the directory should be the following:
/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/include/

Carl
